tools.name: pay_referral_bonus_and_archive_referral
tools.description: Pays an employee their referral bonus for a hired candidate through the payments provider and moves the referral record from the pending referrals table to the paid referrals table.

params.name: referral_id
params.description: ID of the pending referral record

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

DATABASE_PATH = "recruiting.db"


@function_tool
def pay_referral_bonus_and_archive_referral(referral_id: int, bonus_amount_usd: float) -> str:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    pending_referral_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT employee_payout_account, candidate_name FROM pending_referrals WHERE id = ?",
        (referral_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if pending_referral_row is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return "Referral not found"
    employee_payout_account_identifier, hired_candidate_name = pending_referral_row
    created_transfer_object = stripe.Transfer.create(
        amount=int(round(bonus_amount_usd * 100)),
        currency="usd",
        destination=employee_payout_account_identifier,
        description=f"Referral bonus for {hired_candidate_name}",
    )
    database_connection.execute(
        "INSERT INTO paid_referrals (id, employee_payout_account, candidate_name, transfer_id) "
        "SELECT id, employee_payout_account, candidate_name, ? FROM pending_referrals WHERE id = ?",
        (created_transfer_object.id, referral_id),
    )
    database_connection.execute("DELETE FROM pending_referrals WHERE id = ?", (referral_id,))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return f"Paid referral {referral_id}, transfer {created_transfer_object.id}"

tools.name: update_applicant_stage
tools.description: Looks up an applicant's current pipeline stage and moves them to a new stage, recording the change in the applicant's history log. Returns the previous and new stage.

params.name: new_stage
params.description: Target stage such as applied, screening, interview, offer, hired, rejected

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

DB_PATH = "recruiting.db"
VALID_STAGES = ["applied", "screening", "interview", "offer", "hired", "rejected"]


def update_applicant_stage(applicant_id: int, new_stage: str, note: str = "") -> dict:
    result = {
        "success": False,
        "applicant_id": applicant_id,
        "previous_stage": None,
        "new_stage": new_stage,
        "error": None,
    }
    normalized_stage = new_stage.strip().lower()
    if normalized_stage not in VALID_STAGES:
        result["error"] = "Invalid stage. Must be one of: " + ", ".join(VALID_STAGES)
        return result
    result["new_stage"] = normalized_stage

    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            "SELECT full_name, stage FROM applicants WHERE id = ?",
            (applicant_id,),
        )
        row = cur.fetchone()
        if row is None:
            result["error"] = "Applicant not found"
            return result

        full_name, current_stage = row
        result["applicant_name"] = full_name
        result["previous_stage"] = current_stage

        if current_stage == normalized_stage:
            result["error"] = "Applicant is already in this stage"
            return result

        if current_stage in ("hired", "rejected"):
            result["error"] = "Applicant is in a final stage: " + current_stage
            return result

        timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        cur.execute(
            "UPDATE applicants SET stage = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
            (normalized_stage, timestamp, applicant_id),
        )
        cur.execute(
            "INSERT INTO applicant_stage_history (applicant_id, from_stage, to_stage, note, changed_at) "
            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            (applicant_id, current_stage, normalized_stage, note, timestamp),
        )
        conn.commit()
        result["success"] = True
        result["changed_at"] = timestamp
    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
        conn.rollback()
        result["error"] = str(exc)
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return result

tools.name: email_interview_invitation
tools.description: Looks up a candidate's email address and name, then sends them an interview invitation email with the given time and location.

params.name: interview_time
params.description: Interview date and time as text

tools.code:
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from email.message import EmailMessage
from langchain_core.tools import tool


@dataclass
class InvitationResult:
    sent: bool
    recipient: str
    detail: str


@tool
def email_interview_invitation(candidate_id: int, interview_time: str, location: str) -> InvitationResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("recruiting.db")
    row = conn.execute("SELECT name, email FROM candidates WHERE id = ?", (candidate_id,)).fetchone()
    conn.close()
    if row is None:
        return InvitationResult(False, "", "Candidate not found")
    name, email = row
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "recruiting@example.com"
    msg["To"] = email
    msg["Subject"] = "Interview Invitation"
    msg.set_content(f"Hi {name},\n\nWe would like to invite you to interview on {interview_time} at {location}.\n\nRecruiting Team")
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.example.com", 587) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.send_message(msg)
    return InvitationResult(True, email, "Invitation sent")
